description: Gets a proxy a new exit IP. Mobile proxies (proxy_type=0) reconnect to the carrier and pick up a new cellular IP; residential proxies (proxy_type=3) in sticky mode get a new peer, while in rotating mode the IP already changes on every request. Active connections through the proxy drop. Takes ~3-10 seconds, free of charge, with a short cooldown between rotations. verify=true checks the new IP afterwards (adds ~1-2s).

verify.description: Call proxy_ip after rotation to confirm the new IP

name: rotate_ip
title: Rotate proxy IP
